description:
Add session tree navigation: fork creates a branch from an earlier entry;
navigate_tree moves to an earlier point with an optional LLM-generated summary
of the abandoned branch.

Reference: tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/agent-session.ts lines 1146-1163.
Reference: tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/extensions/types.ts
           ExtensionCommandContext.fork and navigateTree lines 341-359.

Depends on: SessionManager (tree structure), Loop migration (Loop threads
session_manager, not messages).

## Session.fork/2

  def fork(pid, entry_id)

GenServer handler:
  1. Verify entry_id exists in state.session_manager.by_id; if not, return {:error, :not_found}.
  2. Capture old_leaf_id = state.session_manager.leaf_id.
  3. Append a CustomEntry to record the fork:
       SessionManager.append_custom_entry(sm, "fork", %{from_leaf_id: old_leaf_id,
                                                          to_entry_id: entry_id})
  4. Set sm.leaf_id = entry_id. (New entries will branch from this point.)
  5. Return {:reply, :ok, %{state | session_manager: updated_sm}}.

## Session.navigate_tree/3

  def navigate_tree(pid, target_entry_id, opts \\ [])
  opts: [summarize: boolean (default false), custom_instructions: String.t()]

GenServer handler:
  1. Verify target_entry_id exists; if not, return {:error, :not_found}.
  2. If opts[:summarize] is true:
     a. Get branch from current leaf back to target_entry_id (the "abandoned" path).
     b. Run an LLM summarization call (same pattern as Compaction.compact/3 but
        using a navigate-specific system prompt:
        "Summarize the following conversation branch that is being abandoned.")
     c. Append %SessionEntry.BranchSummaryEntry{from_id: current_leaf_id, summary: text}.
  3. Set sm.leaf_id = target_entry_id.
  4. Return {:reply, :ok, updated_state}.

## Update build_session_context/1 in SessionManager

Handle BranchSummaryEntry nodes in the branch path:
  When the path from root to leaf contains a BranchSummaryEntry, insert a
  synthetic User message containing the summary text BEFORE the messages that
  follow the branch point. Format: "[Branch summary: #{entry.summary}]"

This is analogous to how CompactionEntry inserts a synthetic summary message.
Update the algorithm in the existing build_session_context/1 implementation.

## Tests

Create apps/octo_pi_agent/test/octo_pi/agent/session_branching_test.exs.
  - fork/2 sets leaf_id to the given entry_id
  - fork/2 returns {:error, :not_found} for unknown entry_id
  - after fork/2, append_message creates a new branch (not connected to old leaf)
  - navigate_tree/3 without summarize just moves leaf_id
  - navigate_tree/3 with summarize: true appends BranchSummaryEntry
  - build_session_context includes "[Branch summary: ...]" message for BranchSummaryEntry
title: Session branching — fork and navigate_tree
